name: list_collections
description: The collections (corpora) in this deployment, each with its own ontology.

caller_private.description: set by the gateway from the caller's token; any value you send is replaced

name: describe_ontology
description: The released ontology of a collection, as its compact agent rendition: types, relations, attributes and synonyms. Read it before querying a collection, and query in its terms.

caller_private.description: set by the gateway from the caller's token; any value you send is replaced

name: search_entities
description: Find entities in the knowledge graph by name or synonym, optionally of one ontology type (its subtypes included).

caller_private.description: set by the gateway from the caller's token; any value you send is replaced

name: list_entities
description: The best-connected entities of an ontology type (its subtypes included).

caller_private.description: set by the gateway from the caller's token; any value you send is replaced

name: get_entity
description: An entity's types, names, attributes and relations, each with the ids of the passages it is stated in.

caller_private.description: set by the gateway from the caller's token; any value you send is replaced

name: neighbourhood
description: The entities within 1 to 3 relations of one entity (default 1), nearest and best connected first, and the relations among them.

caller_private.description: set by the gateway from the caller's token; any value you send is replaced

name: find_paths
description: How two entities are connected: every shortest chain of relations between them, up to max_hops (1 to 4, default 3) long, each relation with its direction. Cite the passages of each relation (get_entity) before stating it.

caller_private.description: set by the gateway from the caller's token; any value you send is replaced

name: describe_structured
description: The mapped tables and named metrics of a collection: each type, its key, its columns, its source and the snapshot it is bound to. Read it before a filter or a total.

caller_private.description: set by the gateway from the caller's token; any value you send is replaced

name: lookup_rows
description: Rows of one mapped type. A filter is an attribute, an operator (eq, neq, lt, lte, gt, gte, prefix) and a value. Each value comes back with its cell id. Pass cell_ids to re-read cells for a citation check.

caller_private.description: set by the gateway from the caller's token; any value you send is replaced

name: aggregate
description: A figure from a mapped table: a metric name, or a type with op (count, sum, min, max, avg), an attribute, one optional group_by, and the same filters as lookup_rows. The figure is recomputed from the snapshot.

caller_private.description: set by the gateway from the caller's token; any value you send is replaced

name: search_passages
description: Search the source passages by what they say; returns each passage's text, id and document. Use it for anything the graph does not hold, and to find the passage behind a fact.

caller_private.description: set by the gateway from the caller's token; any value you send is replaced

name: read_passages
description: The full text of passages by id, with the document each comes from. Read a passage before citing it.

caller_private.description: set by the gateway from the caller's token; any value you send is replaced
